dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL style with SCREEN SECTION, Background-color/Foreground-color clauses, and French-language identifiers; authored by Olivier DOSSMANN

purpose.domain_detail: Bank account management menu system (Gestion de la banque) with options for account import, bank list, account list, RIB key control, and client management
purpose.summary: A French-language interactive menu program for a bank management application. It displays a full-screen menu with the current date and numbered options (1-5 plus 0 to return), accepts user input, and loops until option 0 is selected. The menu options include account import, bank/account listing, RIB key control, and client management, but the actual sub-program calls are not yet implemented (CONTINUE placeholders).

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (Background-color, Foreground-color)
program-id AS clause for external name
Multi-line VALUE literals with continuation lines
verdict.notes: Missing IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header (only program-id and author present, no IDENTIFICATION DIVISION keyword detected by parser). The SCREEN SECTION color syntax and overall style is consistent with GnuCOBOL. The file contains a non-ASCII character in a comment (DATE SYST	at	at	ME - encoding issue with accented character). All EVALUATE branches are CONTINUE stubs, suggesting work in progress. program_type set to unknown-ish; closest is 'online-cics' but it is actually a screen-based terminal program, not CICS.
